Subject: Great to meet at ScaleAI — quick recap & next step

Hi Sanjay / Ellen —

Really enjoyed our conversation at the ScaleAI Summit this morning — thanks for carving out the time. Quick recap so we land on the same page: 

- Your priority: reduce per-request inference cost for real-time product recommendations while keeping 95th-percentile latency under 120ms.
- Current stack: in-house BERT-ish models served on a mix of CPU and single-GPU endpoints; exploring migrating heavy traffic to a managed inference layer.
- Constraints: must meet SOC2-ish controls for PII, VPC peering for staging, and predictable monthly spend forecasts for procurement.

If this looks right, I'd love to schedule a 30-minute discovery call next week to:
1) walk through a quick production-fit checklist (traffic profile, SLA targets, sensitive data flows)
2) show a short demo of how Redwood handles routing/fallbacks and cost controls
3) capture a rough cost/latency estimate for your workload

Open slots: Tue/Wed 11/17–11/18 between 9–11am PT or Fri 11/20 10–11am PT. If those don't work please share a couple alternatives.

I've attached a one-page discovery template to speed up the call if you want to pre-fill any numbers (will send a PDF before the call). Also included the photo of your business card I took at the booth for reference.

Thanks again — excited to explore whether Redwood can give you predictable inference economics without re-architecting your whole pipeline.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
